name: cloudflare-do-sqlite
about: Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite at marginal paid prices, allowance 0 (C10). Every price is read by meter name from the dated price sheets (root price_sheets: cloudflare-durable-objects-sqlite-paid.json and cloudflare-r2-standard.json, as of 2026-10-28, official pages).

prices.basis: DO bills rows scanned (rowsRead). SQLite loop visits are the local proxy until calibration CAL-5 measures their ratio to workerd rowsRead.
DO bills rows written; deletes count as writes.
Official page: an index adds a written row when the write includes the indexed column. Counted per changed index key; CAL-1 must confirm.
Each setAlarm() is billed as one row written (official page footnote).
DO requests, including alarm invocations; allowance ignored.
Sealed history generations are R2 PUTs (Class A).
Cold-tier point reads and cold-page locator rebuilds are R2 GETs (Class B).

storage.basis: SQL stored data per GB-month (allowance ignored); tables and indexes both count.

latency.basis: AI assumption for the storage boundary (in-colo Worker->DO call 0.5 ms). Replace with workerd calibration; wall-clock.json has measured local time.

unpriced.item: DO duration (duration_gb_s, 128 MB per active object)
unpriced.why: priced in the sheet ($12.50 per million GB-s) but the simulation does not meter how long each object stays active; at most 0.128 GB x the seconds an object is awake

unpriced.item: Workers requests and CPU in front of the objects
unpriced.why: priced in cloudflare-workers-paid.json ($0.30 per million requests, $0.02 per million CPU ms) but the storage simulation does not model the Worker hop

unpriced.item: Workers Paid $5 per month and the included allowances
unpriced.why: one per Cloudflare account, shared by every customer of the hosted service, so not a per-team charge
archive_bytes is reported but only one storage gauge is priced
counted as attempted; whether billed is unknown (CAL-7)
local file rewrite that removes erased bytes; on DO physical erasure is the provider's and has no row price
